[[File:Gravitic_Core.jpg|thumb|250px|The Gravitic Core.]]
The '''Gravitic Core''' was a part/power source of [[Kul Teska]]'s [[gravitic polarization beam]] that the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] built for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Two were being transported to [[Behpour/Legends|Behpour]], but the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] hijacked one and destroyed the other over [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]], but Teska [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|retrieved]] it on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].
